description: A massive gameplay overhaul and expansion built on Second Wave and Section 17, reworking nearly every aspect of Planetary Annihilation: TITANS. Features new units, technologies, mechanics and a complete rework of combat, economy, production, vision and detection. H-COM is a standalone PvP overhaul. Second Wave and Section 17 are required dependencies. Incompatible with other server-side gameplay mods and expansions. AI armies are not supported.
author: kasa
